mechanical_checks.render: Every ICU value re-rendered with intl-messageformat (the same library the app uses) at 1 and 3 targets, the target list built by Intl.ListFormat(type=conjunction) exactly as team-bridge-member-events.tsx does; events.others also rendered at count 1,2,3,5,11,21,22,1000000. Verbatim output is in renders below.
mechanical_checks.placeholders: AST diff (@formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser) of every audited value against its English source: identical argument set and element types in all 7 locales; no renamed, dropped or added placeholder, no markup token invented. events.others carries {count} and nothing else everywhere; events.declined_self carries no {targets} anywhere.
mechanical_checks.plural_arms: Arms compared with Intl.PluralRules(locale).resolvedOptions().pluralCategories: fr one/many/other, es one/many/other, zh-CN other, ru one/few/many/other, vi other, ur one/other, hi one/other — an exact match to CLDR at every locale, no missing category and no invented one. The fr and es 'many' arm ('# d’autres' / '# más') also renders correctly at 1000000.
mechanical_checks.others_no_conjunction: Scanned for a conjunction inside events.others: no fr 'et', es 'y', ru 'и', vi 'và', zh '和', ur 'اور', hi 'और' — the platform's ListFormat adds the joiner, as required.
mechanical_checks.keyset: All seven target files hold 297 keys, identical to the English key set; invitation_note_v2 is absent from every locale (verified by key scan, not by the translator's summary).
mechanical_checks.glossary: i18n/glossary.md line 46 (agent → agente · 智能体 · агент · tác nhân · ایجنٹ · एजेंट) holds in every audited line; member terms match each locale's members.title/member.count (membres, miembros, 成员, участник, thành viên, ارکان, सदस्य); mute matches notify.mute in all 7; thread matches replies.title in all 7; owner matches members.role.owner in fr/es/zh-CN/ru/vi/ur/hi.
mechanical_checks.register: Address forms match each locale's style guide: fr vous, es tú, zh-CN 你, vi bạn, ur آپ, hi आप, ru вы lowercase. No locale mixes T/V inside the audited group. Capitalisation is sentence case everywhere.
mechanical_checks.ru_style: The ru colon/impersonal construction was judged against i18n/style-guides/ru.md ('prefer impersonal constructions where the English allows') and against the ru namespace's existing precedent — invitations.declined '{agent}: приглашение отклонено.' and invitations.declined_unnamed 'Ваш агент: приглашение отклонено.' — so the pattern reads as an established ru system line, not a calque. Two lines deviate in meaning or shape (RU-B1, RU-B2); the em-dash separator ' — {targets}' is new to this namespace but reads as a structured log line and is not a finding on its own.
mechanical_checks.independence: This auditor read the English source, the context sidecar, all seven target files, the glossary and the style guides directly; no translator summary was taken on trust, and no other auditor's receipt was read before the verdicts above were written.

findings.current: {actor} đã thêm tác nhân {targets} của mình
findings.proposed: {actor} đã thêm tác nhân của mình là {targets}
findings.reason: The reflexive possessive trails the whole name list, so with three targets ('… tác nhân Ava, Ben và Cleo của mình') 'của mình' reads as attaching to the last name and the singular 'tác nhân' + list reads as one agent with three names. Moving the possessive ahead of the list keeps the reflexive reference to the actor unambiguous for one name and for several.

findings.current: {targets} đã tham gia cuộc trò chuyện
findings.reason: Adds 'cuộc trò chuyện' where English says only 'joined', taking the line to 2.3x the source in a truncating row. The timeline already sits in the conversation, so the object is inferable; dropping it is both shorter and closer to the source. Meaning is not affected either way.

findings.current: Danh sách thành viên đã thay đổi
findings.reason: Says the member *list* changed rather than that the membership changed; 'danh sách' adds a concrete object the English does not have. The shorter form stays calm and generic, which is what this fallback line needs.

invitation_note_v3_fidelity: clause-by-clause: (1) không cấp quyền cho đến khi được chấp nhận ✓ (2) tác nhân của chính bạn ngay / của người khác khi chủ sở hữu đồng ý ✓ (3) đọc mọi tin nhắn, tự quyết định, 'được kỳ vọng sẽ trả lời' — expectation, not luôn ✓ (4) giới hạn trong @-mentions và các luồng, hoặc tắt tiếng ✓; luồng matches replies.title, tắt tiếng matches notify.mute.
